_comment: Shared parity fixture for T786: the JS TextUtils.sanitizeControlCharacters (textUtils.js) and the Python sanitize_control_characters (chronos_settings_widgets_worldclocks.py) implement one rule for one string - a world clock's Display name, which the dialog persists and the runtime reads back. They had already drifted twice: the line separators (T783) and the bidi overrides (T833) were added to the JS side alone, so the dialog saved what the applet then had to strip. textUtils.test.js and test_settings_widgets_core.py each assert against this table, so a one-sided change fails one suite. Code points are given as numbers because a control character in a JSON string is not readable, and the expected value is what "a<CP>b" sanitizes to.

removed.why: ESC - starts an ANSI/OSC sequence in a log
NEL - a line break to Pango
U+2028 LINE SEPARATOR - category Zl, not Cc
U+202E RIGHT-TO-LEFT OVERRIDE - reverses everything after it

kept.why: U+202F NARROW NO-BREAK SPACE, just past the overrides
U+2065, unassigned and just before the isolates
U+206A, deprecated and acted on by no renderer
an astral code point is not a control character

runs.why: a run of removals collapses to one space
an override beside a C0 control is still one space
